description: Move a page within its space: under another page (`parentId`), to the top level (`parentId: null`), or to a position among its siblings (`index`, from 0).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

index.description: Position among its new siblings, from 0.

parentId.description: The new parent page id, or null for the top level.

name: anyforge_move_page
title: Move page
